data.name: Survive 10,000 B.C.
data.detailed_description:
The ice age is ending. Your story is just beginning.

Welcome to the European Alps, 10,000 B.C. The glaciers are melting, carving out a beautiful yet devastatingly hostile new world. There is no iron to shield you. No concrete to shelter you. No modern medicine to save you. Out here, nature rules with a stone fist, and the predators are not afraid of you. In this game, you are not a conqueror, you are fragile prey.

Key Features:

  • Authentic Prehistoric Survival: Experience the end of nomadic lifestyle of mankind. Build primitive huts, construct drying racks to preserve your food, craft essential Stone Age tools and arrowheads from the raw materials that can be found around you.

  • A Beautiful, Deadly Frontier: Explore a stunning, dynamic landscape of melting glaciers, roaring alpine rivers, and foggy, unforgiving valleys. But don't let the beauty fool you - hypothermia, starvation, food poisoning and deadly disease are always one misstep away.

  • Master Primitive Medicine: Knowledge is the difference between life and death. The alpine flora holds the keys to your survival. Learn to harvest medicinal plants to heal your wounds, but beware - one leaf heals, while another kills.

  • You Are Not the Apex Predator: Share the wild with lethal prehistoric fauna. From stealthy wolves to massive beasts, the local wildlife is smarter, faster, and stronger than you. Track your prey carefully and always watch your back - you might be the one being hunted.

Mechanics: Hunting, Gathering, Trapping, Tracking, Crafting, Building, Wounds, Infections, Diseases, Plant-Based Medicine, Drying and Smoking Food, Action-Based Learning, Cold, Heat, Hunger, Thirst.

Developmental Note:

The game is currently in development. Wishlist now on Steam to follow our journey back to 10,000 B.C. and be the first to step into the prehistoric wild once the game releases!

data.short_description: 12,000 years ago, the ice is retreating, and humanity is expanding north. Survive 10.000 B.C. is a brutal prehistoric survival game set in the unforgiving European Alps. Nature is abundant but everything is a threat. Forage, craft, hunt, and survive.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10 or 11 operating system
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 3.3 GHz or AMD equivalent processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 6 GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

content_descriptors.notes: Since it is a survival game, diseases and bleeding wounds are part of the gameplay.
